flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Open the first product.
Get the product name and save as {{product_name}}.
Click "Add to cart" without ticking or choosing any extra options.
Then open the cart.
Get the names of every line item in the cart, separated by " | ", and save as {{cart_items}}.
Get how many different line items are in the cart and save as {{cart_line_count}}.
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
